description: Lists the rosters players have made public on Praetorium, as the rosters page's public tab shows them, most recently saved first unless sort says otherwise. Each roster has its id, url, name, owner, faction, detachments, battle size, points under today's army data and problem, the first thing stopping it being fielded or null when it is legal. total counts every match when it is known. A page can come back short while nextCursor is set; keep paging until it is null. Read one with get_public_roster. These are players' own lists, not tournament results: for what wins, use list_winning_lists.

battleSize.description: Only rosters built for this battle size in points, such as 2000.

before.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

detachment.description: With faction, a detachment id, slug, or name from list_units, to list only rosters that took it.

faction.description: Faction id, URL slug, or display name from list_factions.

legalOnly.description: Only rosters the current army data can field without problems.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

q.description: Text matched against roster, owner, faction and detachment names.

sort.description: updated-desc, the default, lists the most recently saved first.

name: list_public_rosters
title: List public rosters
